    Wicked: One Wonderful Night is a 2025 American television special celebrating the release of Wicked: For Good (2025), the final film in Universal Pictures' two-part adaptation of the musical Wicked by Stephen Schwartz and Winnie Holzman. The two-hour concert features performances by the film cast, led by Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande, and includes songs from the first Wicked film and For Good. A soundtrack album containing the songs performed on the special was released on November 7, 2025.
    Wicked: One Wonderful Night aired on NBC on November 6, 2025. It was made available for streaming on Peacock the following day.
